title: Trump cancels planned attack on Iran, saying he reached an agreement over the 'perimeters of a deal'
summary_full: The U.S. president said Iran and its regional neighbors asked the U.S. to hold off on attacks after 'the perimeters of a deal has been agreed to.'
summary_public: The U.S. president said Iran and its regional neighbors asked the U.S. to hold off on attacks after 'the perimeters of a deal has been agreed to.'

IR.label: neutral
IR.evidence: Trump threatened to intensify the American campaign against Iran.
